Pretupid Client 0.1.5 is the biggest update yet: it now runs on eight Minecraft versions, from 1.21.9 to 26.3, and brings chat emoji, Freecam, a camera path editor, screenies with a meme maker, a new waypoint system and fully custom nametags. The Pretupid Launcher installs the right build for your instance. Playing with another launcher? Download the jar that matches your Minecraft version and drop it into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API.

## What's new

### More Minecraft versions
- **One client, eight versions:** Minecraft 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3, all with the same features.
- **Joining friends:** if a friend plays on another Minecraft version, the client tells you which version to start instead of failing to connect. Servers that accept several versions can still be joined.
- **Keybinds travel with you:** your keys are now saved by name, so shared settings work on every version.

### Chat emoji
- **Discord-style emoji:** type `:sob:`, `:fire:` or any of 1,900 Twemoji names, or pick one from the new emoji button in chat. Start typing `:` for suggestions.
- **Clean for everyone:** Pretupid players see the emoji; players without Pretupid Client see your message without the codes.

### Screenies and memes
- **Press F4:** grab a screenshot without the HUD at up to three times your screen size.
- **Screenie Studio:** filters, brightness, contrast, warmth and vignette, text you can drag anywhere, and meme layouts: top and bottom text, caption and poster, with ideas to start from.
- **Save or send:** save the full-size picture to `screenshots/pretupid` or send it straight to a friend.

### Freecam and Cinematic Studio
- **Freecam (F6):** fly the camera away from your player. Always allowed in singleplayer; on servers it follows the server rules and cannot pass through blocks.
- **Cinematic Studio (J):** place camera keyframes with K, drag them on a timeline, set zoom and tilt, and play smooth shots with cinema bars.

### Waypoints, rebuilt
- **Waypoint manager (N):** add, rename, recolour, hide and copy waypoints, sorted by dimension.
- **Markers in the world:** every waypoint shows its name and distance where it is, and points the way from the screen edge.
- **Smarter:** death points clear themselves when you get back, and Overworld and Nether coordinates are converted for you.

### Cosmetics
- **Your own nametag:** colour animation, motion, both colours, speed and bold are all yours to combine. Presets are still there as a starting point, and other Pretupid players see exactly your style.
- **Dead Pose emote:** fall flat on your face like a certain cartoon dad. Sneak to get up.

### Smaller things
- **Scrolling descriptions:** long module descriptions scroll so you can read them, or show the full text when you hover.
- **For server owners:** `/pretupid serverrules` lists every module ID with a ready-to-copy example.

## Downloads
- **Client mod:** one jar per Minecraft version, for example `pretupid-client-0.1.5+mc26.3.jar` or `pretupid-client-0.1.5+mc1.21.11.jar`
- **Source:** the source code archives below

The launcher updates Pretupid Client to 0.1.5 on its own, and the client offers the update in-game as well.
